description.en: Industry-standard, ultra-high-performance JavaScript timeline animation engine.
description.zh: 业界标杆级、极高运行性能的专业 JavaScript 时间轴动画核心引擎。

content.en: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) is the industry standard for high-performance timeline choreographies and scroll animations. Trusted by leading creative agencies worldwide, GSAP animates CSS properties, SVG paths, Canvas, and WebGL with unmatched cross-browser consistency and microsecond precision.
content.zh: GSAP（GreenSock Animation Platform）是全球创意交互网站与高端商业站点的核心动画引擎。凭借历经二十年打磨的惊人性能优化与微秒级时间轴编排系统，它能够无缝驱动 CSS、SVG 路径变形、Canvas 以及 Three.js 场景，消除浏览器渲染掉帧与兼容性烦恼。
